package composed

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "iter"
 "testing"

 "github.com/Cyenoch/cordis/contract"
)

type ticker struct{ produced *int }

func (t ticker) Count(ctx context.Context, input TickerCountRequest) iter.Seq2[TickerCountResponse, error] {
 return func(yield func(TickerCountResponse, error) bool) {
  upto, _ := input.Upto.Int64()
  for i := 0; i < int(upto); i++ {
   *t.produced++
   if i == 5 { yield(TickerCountResponse{}, errors.New("five is too many")); return }
   if !yield(TickerCountResponse{Value: json.Number(string(rune('0' + i)))}, nil) { return }
  }
 }
}
func (ticker) Name(context.Context, TickerNameRequest) (TickerNameResponse, error) { return "ticker", nil }

// remote hides the implementation, so that the client encodes and decodes
// as it does across a session.
type remote struct{ contract.Endpoint }

func TestStreamingMethod(t *testing.T) {
 for name, wrap := range map[string]func(contract.Endpoint) contract.Endpoint{
  "same process": func(e contract.Endpoint) contract.Endpoint { return e },
  "encoded":      func(e contract.Endpoint) contract.Endpoint { return remote{e} },
 } {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   produced := 0
   client, err := NewTickerClient(wrap(NewTickerEndpoint(ticker{&produced})))
   if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
   // Item by item, and stopping early stops the provider.
   var got []string
   for item, err := range client.Count(context.Background(), TickerCountRequest{Upto: "4"}) {
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    got = append(got, item.Value.String())
    if len(got) == 2 { break }
   }
   if len(got) != 2 || got[0] != "0" || got[1] != "1" || produced != 2 { t.Fatalf("items %v, produced %d", got, produced) }
   // The items a provider produced precede its error.
   got, produced = nil, 0
   var failure error
   for item, err := range client.Count(context.Background(), TickerCountRequest{Upto: "9"}) {
    if err != nil { failure = err; break }
    got = append(got, item.Value.String())
   }
   if len(got) != 5 || failure == nil { t.Fatalf("items %v, error %v", got, failure) }
   // Input is validated on both paths.
   failure = nil
   for _, err := range client.Count(context.Background(), TickerCountRequest{Upto: "-1"}) { failure = err }
   if failure == nil { t.Fatal("an input its schema rejects was accepted") }
   if out, err := client.Name(context.Background(), TickerNameRequest{}); err != nil || out != "ticker" { t.Fatalf("plain method: %v %v", out, err) }
  })
 }
}
